articles.summary: JEFFERSON CITY, Mo., July 30, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Hawthorn Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: HWBK) , (the “Company”), the bank holding company for Hawthorn Bank, reported second quarter 2025 net income of $6.1 million, or earnings per diluted share (“EPS”) of $0.88. Second Quarter 2025 Results Net income improved $1.5 million, or 31.8% , to $6.1 million from the second quarter 2024 (the "prior year quarter") and the efficiency ratio improved to 62.32% compared to 66.24% for the prior year quarter EP
articles.title: Hawthorn Bancshares Reports Second Quarter 2025 Results
